inputs.text: A Wisconsin jury convicted Harry Wait of election fraud and identity theft after he requested ballots for Assembly Speaker Robin Vos and Racine Mayor Cory Mason without their consent. Whatever the claimed motive, using other people’s identities to stage an election-security stunt can undermine trust—and give cover to those who want to make voting harder. The answer is safeguards that protect voters without piling new barriers onto people who already face obstacles to participating.
